messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to enable speculative decoding + KV prefetch in the runtime canary tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC for ~5% traffic (audience slice B). Quick check: any blockers? I will post the rollout config in a sec.
Priya: Need to confirm metrics we’ll watch: latency p50/p95/p99, cost per token, and hallucination/regression rate on the eval set. Who owns the eval prompts? :thinking_face:
Marta: I can own evals and dashboards. Add me to the canary audience. Also request: add a manual guardrail — if p99 > 350ms or hallucination delta > 2% -> automatic rollback.
Jon: Please share the RC branch and the kernel fallback policy. We must ensure flash-attn fallback to generic kernels on failures. Will review the kernel guardrail matrix.
Alex: Branch: `release/specdec-kvprefetch-rc1`. Quick config snippet below (will push as a feature flag entry):
```
{
  "speculative_decoding": {"enabled": true, "audience": "slice-b", "rate": 0.05, "max_lookahead": 4},
  "kv_prefetch": {"enabled": true, "window_ms": 12, "prefetch_limit": 8},
  "fallbacks": {"flash_attn": true, "generic_kernel": true}
}
```
Sam: I can run smoke/load tests on dedicated infra after you merge. Can we also set a soft concurrency cap for the canary (e.g., max_concurrency: 200) to avoid queue amplification?
deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z to audience slice-b. Notifying on-call. :bell:
Priya: Make sure trace propagation includes a canary flag header (X-Trace-Canary: slice-b) so we can filter traces easily. Also wire up the eval harness to tag results with `specdec_v1`.
Marta: Done — I added `specdec_v1` eval set to the ops dashboard and configured alert thresholds. Will post graphs in #eng-runtime once the first 1k requests are through.
Alex: Great. If no objections I'll flip tomorrow at 09:00 UTC. Tagging @Sam @Marta for final readiness check.
Sam: LGTM, will be standing by.
Jon: Quick note — during review I found a race in KV cache eviction when prefetch window is non-zero. I'll open a small PR to add a mutex around eviction path; low risk but worth backporting if we see anomalies.
Alex: Thanks everyone. We'll keep the canary small and monitor. If Marta's alerts trip or latency spikes, we rollback. :thumbsup:
